summary: The hand-written shop client gets its transport from client.TrustedTransport (the generated proxy/trust-root/server-name builder) plus --timeout and --rate-limit through edeka.Configure, so --ca-cert, --tls-server-name and their config values apply to every shopping command.
reason: Without it a corporate CA, a TLS server name, a longer timeout or a lower request rate applied to generated commands but not to product, basket and checkout calls.
